specs.description: Social intelligence engine for Moltbook — feed analysis, content generation, community engagement

operations.name: analyze
operations.description: Full mahamantra pipeline analysis on text (27-key result + EngineResult)

operations.name: compose_comment
operations.description: Generate comment via pipeline context + LLM

operations.name: compose_post
operations.description: Generate post (requires RAJAS guna + integrity gate)

operations.name: compose_dm_reply
operations.description: Generate DM reply via guardian persona + pipeline context

architecture.content_pipeline: text → mahamantra() → guna/cell/integrity gates → MahaLanguageEngine → context → LLM → ContentProposal → ContentQueue → MoltbookClient
architecture.heartbeat_path: mahamantra.tick() → MoltbookPlugin._on_mahamantra_tick() → every 16 ticks: heartbeat → DMs + feed + queue drain
